acceptance_criteria.criterion: A <textarea> with label "Notes" is visible below the repository status table on the workspace detail view.
Typing in the textarea triggers an API save after 1000 ms of inactivity.
A "Saving…" indicator appears during the save request.
A "Saved" indicator appears after a successful save.
Navigating away and returning to the workspace shows the persisted notes.
The textarea is pre-populated with existing notes on page load.

summary: Added buildNotesSection() helper in workspace-detail.js that builds a <section class='workspace-notes-section'> with: a <label for='workspace-notes-textarea'>Notes</label>, a <textarea id='workspace-notes-textarea'> pre-populated from workspace.notes, and a <span class='workspace-notes-status' aria-live='polite'> for 'Saving…'/'Saved' feedback.
Wired a 1000 ms debounced input listener that calls api.workspaces.update(projectId, wid, { notes: value }) on change.
Notes section appended to the view container after the Switch Branches button (below the status table).
Created workspace-detail.notes.test.mjs with 7 tests covering all 6 acceptance criteria.
780/780 backend tests pass, 58/58 GUI tests pass (7 new notes tests + 51 pre-existing). TypeScript compile clean.

comments.note: workspace-detail.js is a large file (~1260 lines). The buildNotesSection helper fits the existing builder pattern well. No structural concerns introduced by this change.

summary: Build check: TypeScript compiles clean, no errors.

AC verification: all 6 ACs confirmed via 7 route-level GUI tests (notes textarea present, label 'Notes', pre-populated on load, debounce triggers api.workspaces.update at 1000ms, 'Saving…' visible in-flight, 'Saved' visible on success).
Regression: 153/153 GUI tests pass, 781/781 backend tests pass, 0 failures.

comments.note: Defensive edge-case: save-error path (try/catch in debounce shows 'Save failed.') has no test, but is not required by AC. The error case is handled gracefully and the code is correct. Low-priority test gap.

AC5 (navigate away and return) is covered implicitly: workspace.notes is pre-populated from api.workspaces.get on every render. Since the API persists data, a fresh render always reflects the last saved value. No deeper integration test is needed at this layer.

summary: Code review PASS. buildNotesSection() in workspace-detail.js is well-architected: clean DOM builder following the existing buildX pattern, proper closure-scoped debounce timer, aria-live='polite' on the status span, and try/catch error handling. Integration at renderWorkspaceDetail is minimal and correct. Test suite in workspace-detail.notes.test.mjs uses a sophisticated but correct timer-stub approach (replacing globalThis.setTimeout per render) and covers all 6 ACs. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: The 'Saving…' indicator test (mid-flight DOM inspection) fires fn() without awaiting it to observe the in-progress state, then resolves the held promise. This is correct but fragile: it relies on the async handler reaching the first `await` within the same microtask tick. The test passes reliably in Node.js due to the synchronous setup of statusEl.textContent before the first await, but a code comment explaining the intent would reduce future confusion.

[documentation-forward] buildNotesSection() is a new exported-style helper in workspace-detail.js. The GUI frontend manifest (docs/agents/project-manifest/gui-frontend.md) should document this helper and its parameters (initialNotes, onSave) for future contributors building on or modifying the notes feature.
